summary: Two filing-grade compliance sections (OET-65 RF Exposure, §17.4 Tower Study) are fully implemented in engineeringReport/sections/ but never imported or wired into engineeringReport/index.js — every Genoa exhibit silently ships without §1.1310/OET-65 and Part 17 in the body. Three operational-compliance items (license expiration, public-file folder URL, State EAS Plan) also have no renderer surface. Checklist item #6 (AM §73.182 NIF narrative) PASS — amNightNarrative correctly wired via appendices.js.

findings.title: OET-65 / §1.1310 RF Exposure section orphaned — buildRfExposureSection defined but never imported by engineeringReport/index.js
findings.recommended_fix: Import buildRfExposureSection into engineeringReport/index.js and slot into the build pipeline at the §1.1310 RF Exposure position. Three-way co-sign per PR-RENDER cluster.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Cross-confirmed by fcc-auditor A-001 (BLOCKER) and technical-pmp PMP-002. 3rd cycle for this dedup hash.

findings.title: §17.4 Tower Study section orphaned — buildTowerStudySection defined but never imported by engineeringReport/index.js
findings.recommended_fix: Import buildTowerStudySection into engineeringReport/index.js. Same PR-RENDER cluster as F-001.
findings.reproducibility_notes: Same orphan-section root cause as F-001 / A-001 / PMP-002.

findings.title: License expiration date has no renderer surface even though fccLmsClient populates it
findings.recommended_fix: Surface the license expiration date from the LMS client into the facility-parameters table or licensing block.
tests_required: snapshot test on facility-parameters block for AM/FM exhibit
findings.reproducibility_notes: fccLmsClient already returns license_expiration_date; no consumer renders it.

findings.title: Public-file folder URL has no renderer surface even though fccLmsClient populates it
findings.recommended_fix: Surface the public-file folder URL from the LMS client into the exhibit footer or licensing block.
findings.reproducibility_notes: fccLmsClient returns public_file_url; no consumer renders it.

findings.title: State EAS Plan citation missing from compliance attestation
findings.recommended_fix: Add state-EAS-plan citation to the compliance attestation block; can be parameterized by state code.
tests_required: assert the State EAS Plan reference appears in the attestation block
findings.reproducibility_notes: Part 11 requires participation in state EAS plans; current attestation omits this.

findings.title: AM §73.182 NIF narrative correctly wired via appendices.js (PASS)
findings.recommended_fix: No action. Recording the passing state so future audits can dedup against unchanged behavior.
findings.reproducibility_notes: amNightNarrative is imported and called from appendices.js; renders in AM exhibits as expected.
